Game Overview

In Fitness Race, the core idea is straightforward: "Fitness Race" combines the excitement of racing with a focus on nutrition. Guide your runner through a dynamic track, carefully balancing healthy and unhealthy food choices to meet weight goals. Navigate this unique blend of strategy and movement to achieve fitness success, all wrapped in a fun, casual experience.
